bibl.title: Kings, Gods and Heroes in a Dynastic Perspective. A Comparative Approach.
bibl.seg: Alessandra Coppola, Kings, Gods and Heroes in a Dynastic Perspective. A Comparative Approach.
bibl.note: Paper presented at the panel Meet the New Gods, Same as the Old Gods? Formulary, Ritual, and Status in Hellenistic Ruler Cult, hosted by the 8th Celtic Conference in Classics, Edinburgh, June 25-28, 2014. - 1. Dynastic continuity in the centralized cult. - 2. Dynastic continuity in civic cults. - 3. Human and mythic founders. - 4. Heroes and gods as ancestors and patrons of the royal family. - 5. Survivals and conclusive remarks.
